email.draftExplainer: Cogeto će napisati prijedlog odgovora koji možete urediti i sami poslati. Nikad ne šalje e-poštu. Odobravate i šaljete iz vlastitog programa.

read.title: What Cogeto read

outcome.needs_vision: Needs reading by a vision model

reason.row_cap_sheet: This file is longer than the per-sheet row limit, so Cogeto read the first rows of each sheet.
reason.row_cap_file: This file is longer than the row limit for one file, so Cogeto stopped once the limit was reached.
reason.no_text: Cogeto found no readable text in this file. Nothing was extracted, and nothing was invented.
reason.unsupported_type: Cogeto does not read this kind of file yet.
reason.legacy_office_format: This is a pre-2007 Office file. Save it as .docx or .xlsx and upload it again.
reason.parse_failed: The file is of a kind Cogeto reads, but these bytes could not be parsed. It may be corrupt or password protected.
reason.parse_timeout: Reading this file took too long and was stopped.
reason.text_over_cap: This file expands to more text than Cogeto reads from one document.
reason.undecodable_text: The text in this file could not be decoded.
reason.vision_unavailable: Some pages are pictures. Reading them needs a vision model, which this instance does not have working. Nothing was invented for those pages; the original is kept, so they can be read once it is available.
reason.vision_cap_reached: This document reached its limit for pages read by a vision model. The pages beyond it were left unread rather than silently skipped.
reason.vision_failed: A page needed a vision model and the attempt failed. The original is kept and can be read again.
reason.no_readable_text: Cogeto could not find readable text on this document, by any means available to it. Nothing was extracted, and nothing was invented.

read.valuesUnavailable_one: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.
read.valuesUnavailable_few: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.
read.valuesUnavailable_other: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.

tier.title: How each page was read
tier.visionPages_one: {{count}} pages were read by a vision model.
tier.visionPages_few: {{count}} pages were read by a vision model.
tier.visionPages_other: {{count}} pages were read by a vision model.

reprocess.explainer: The original is kept, so this can be read again once the missing capability is available. Facts already stored are reconciled, not duplicated.
reprocess.queued: Queued. The document will be read again in the background.
reprocess.noBytes: The original was discarded after extraction, so there is nothing left to read again.

anchor.title: Document context
anchor.none: No context was detected for this document.
anchor.detected: Detected automatically from the document opening.
anchor.edited: Corrected by you. Automatic anchoring will not overwrite it.
anchor.saveHint: Saved. Reprocess the file to re-anchor its facts to the corrected context.
